tools.name: ads_report_issue
tools.description: Report a contradiction, silently ignored field, saved display/preview mismatch, or broken tool contract. Include expected and actual results and relevant IDs. The server redacts sensitive text and logs the report for the Ads Uploader team to review. Returns { reported: true, reference, status: 'queued' }. Limited to 10 reports per user per hour. Available to every MCP/CLI user.

tools.name: ads_request_feature
tools.description: Tell the Ads Uploader team about a capability you need that these tools do not offer. Call this yourself, without asking the user or waiting for permission, whenever a user goal cannot be done with the available tools or parameters (a missing tool, field, filter, action or level). Then carry on: tell the user what was not possible and continue with the best available workaround. Describe the missing capability, not the user: no names, emails, ad copy, tokens or other personal data. Similar requests are grouped and counted. Use ads_report_issue instead when an existing tool misbehaves. Returns { requested: true, reference, status: 'recorded' }. Limited to 20 requests per user per hour. Available to every MCP/CLI user.

search.description: Optional text matched against supported field IDs, labels, kinds, and groups.

kind.description: Optional catalog kind. Use breakdown to discover values for query.breakdowns, not query.fields.

group.description: Optional exact catalog group such as delivery, conversions, video, identity, breakdown, or date.

tools.name: ads_query_insights
tools.description: Query one bounded page per account of Ads Insights for one account or 2 to 5 accountIds, with table rows by default. Use friendly metrics such as leads, purchases and roas for business questions. Omitted counts and values are 0 with delivery (impressions > 0) and null otherwise; a positive count without an action value stays null. Native result indicators with empty values are 0 on delivered rows; cost per result stays null for zero results. Use results and cost_per_result to assess optimization goals at campaign, ad set or ad level. Missing native results can be derived from ad set setup and delivery; incomplete data stays unknown. Discover fields by search or group. Asset breakdowns analyze flexible or dynamic creative ads; use each alone. For audience segment mix (prospecting / engaged / existing customers) use breakdowns: [user_segment_key] alone, with timeIncrement weekly or monthly for share of spend over time. Request only needed columns and use paging.after to continue only when needed. Reach, frequency, and CTR are non-additive, so never sum them across rows. Empty rows are successful. Zero-impression rows are excluded by default (excludeZeroImpressions: true); set false to include zero rows. Compare keeps a row if either period has impressions above zero, including drops to zero. Use compare for vs last period or previous-year questions. Requested fields stay visible; friendly formulas are evaluated per period and native result values match by indicator and attribution window. Uncomparable fields retain current values with COMPARE_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED listing the fields. Use include for status, budget, targeting or creative context instead of separate list calls. Targeting geo includes countries; country_groups with key/label (eea = European Economic Area (EEA)); region and geo-market names; cities with radius/unit; zip/custom-location samples; location_types; and the same fields under geo.excluded. Each list is capped at 25 with full singular counts (country_count, country_group_count, region_count, city_count, geo_market_count, zip_count, custom_location_count, location_type_count) and truncated: true on its container when capped. Additional geo dimensions are retained. flexible_spec groups contain capped interest, behavior and demographic names with per-list counts and flexible_spec_count. Custom audience lists are capped and counted. Use accountIds for cross-account views; never add totals across accounts. Account-level cell estimates use one row per account without breakdowns or time buckets, then multiply bounded buckets/breakdowns and cap by limit. Multi-account pages use paging.byAccount and an after cursor map; set completed accounts to null. A status: pending result means call ads_get_insights_job with job.id; never re-run the query to check progress. Cached results carry meta.cache.ageSeconds; fresh skips the cache read. On 429, report the Retry-After wait and do not retry in a loop. Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

mode.description: auto uses async for heavy queries. sync caps daily ranges at 90 days; async supports up to 400.

fresh.description: Skip the cache read but still cache the refreshed result.

accountId.description: Ad account ID used for the X-Ad-Account header, e.g. act_123. It is not sent in the Insights request body.

level.description: Entity level for each result row. Defaults to account.

fields.description: Friendly business metrics or native fields. Use results/cost_per_result for optimization goals at campaign, ad set or ad level; missing native results can be derived from ad set setup and delivery. Discover with search/group. Custom conversions use custom_conversion.<id>, custom_conversion_value.<id>, cost_per_custom_conversion.<id>.

actionTypes.description: Optional Meta action_type values used to select and flatten action-family fields such as actions or cost_per_action_type.

datePreset.description: Named Meta date preset. Mutually exclusive with timeRange. Defaults to last_30d when neither date option is supplied.

since.description: Inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

until.description: Inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

timeRange.description: Explicit current date range, mutually exclusive with datePreset. Use compare for a previous period, previous year or custom range.

timeIncrement.description: Time bucketing for rows. all_days returns one aggregate bucket; daily is limited to 90 days in sync mode or 400 in auto/async mode.

breakdowns.description: At most two breakdowns. Asset, media and hourly breakdowns must each be used alone. Use asset breakdowns for flexible/dynamic creative. user_segment_key = audience segment (prospecting / engaged / existing customers); use alone.

campaignIds.description: Campaign IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

adSetIds.description: Ad set IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

adIds.description: Ad IDs included in the result. IDs are matched with Meta's IN filter.

filters.description: Optional entity ID filters. Use the filter matching the IDs you already know.

useAccountSetting.description: Use the ad account attribution setting. Defaults to true and cannot be true when explicit windows are supplied.

windows.description: Explicit Meta action attribution windows. Supplying windows selects explicit attribution instead of the account setting.

reportTime.description: Time basis for attributed actions. Omit it to use Meta's default reporting behavior.

attribution.description: Attribution controls echoed in response.meta. Omit this object to follow the account setting.

field.description: One requested native scalar field to sort by. Action-family fields cannot be sorted.

limit.description: Maximum rows in this one bounded Meta page. Reduce it when a wide result approaches the MCP output budget. Defaults to 10 rows when include is set and limit is omitted (25 otherwise). Explicit limits are unchanged.

after.description: Single-account opaque cursor, or account-to-cursor map for accountIds. Use canonical act_ IDs. Omit an account for its first page; null marks an exhausted account. Keep the query unchanged.

actionBreakdowns.description: Defaults to action_type. Other dimensions produce actionRows/actionColumns and cannot be used with friendly metrics. action_type is always included.

where.description: Numeric comparisons, string name filters, status in/not_in, or objective in. Values are numbers for metrics, strings for names, arrays for in/not_in.

excludeZeroImpressions.description: Defaults to true: drops zero-impression rows (adds impressions > 0 to Meta filtering). Set false to include them. Compare keeps a row if either period has impressions.

format.description: table returns row arrays in column order, including actionRows. objects returns keyed rows.

accountIds.description: 2 to 5 distinct accounts instead of accountId. Sequential, synchronous pages with each account currency and timezone. Never add totals across accounts.

since.description: Inclusive range start in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

until.description: Inclusive range end in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the ad account timezone.

compare.description: Use for vs last period comparisons. Requires all_days and sync execution; maximum/data_maximum and non-default actionBreakdowns are unsupported. Previous values and changes appear beside each numeric metric; null means unavailable.

include.description: Use for status, budget or creative context instead of separate list calls. Separate entities maps are linked to rows by meta.entityRefs, with summaries for targeting and creative assets. Defaults to 10 rows when include is set and limit is omitted (25 otherwise). Explicit limits are unchanged.

Reporting 429 responses carry Retry-After. ROW_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means wait until meta.quota.resetsAt (or the error quota reset); do not retry before then.

after.description: Opaque paging.after cursor from this job's previous page.

limit.description: Maximum rows; defaults to the original query limit.

waitSeconds.description: Long-poll duration. Follow pollAfterSeconds while the job is running.

format.description: table returns row arrays in column order, including actionRows. objects returns keyed rows.

tools.name: ads_save_build
tools.description: Create a durable saved build for the authenticated user. A spec-only build is supported and preferred for agent-created configurations because the web uploader hydrates it and generates its own webState on resume. Portable specs support the full v1 launch surface, including campaign-qualified texts.perAdset entries and per-campaign profile.campaigns identity overrides. Web-captured builds can launch without uploadId when spec.mediaItems carries a mediaHash for every image and mediaId for every video, with missing library-video thumbnails recovered from Meta at preview/create. Do not construct webState by hand. Only provide webState when round-tripping a webState previously read from a build without changing its structure. accountId is optional when it can be derived from webState.selectedAccount.accountId, webState.selectedAccount.account_id, or spec.accountId. Confirm that the build was saved. If the user has an open uploader tab, do not repeat the returned url; share it only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. For a new headless build with no open uploader tab, give the returned url so the user can open and review it. Use ads_create with buildId to launch it when spec.launchable is true. launchable only describes headless ads_create launches; a launchable:false build still opens and can be edited in the web uploader. Unresolved video identifiers must be repaired before launch. Missing library-video thumbnails are recovered from Meta at preview/create; only the thumbnail image is uploaded, never the video. For videos, mediaItems[].mediaId MUST be the numeric Facebook video id from the upload response videoId, not its internal id. videoId is accepted as an alias. linkedAssets[] follow the same rule. Internal upload ids are resolved on save only for uploads owned by the authenticated user in the selected account; otherwise a video without a numeric id or batch link makes the build unlaunchable. Canonical 4x5 primary with linked 9x16 item: {"mediaName":"X__H01.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1805649190475379","thumbnailHash":"PRIMARY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"portrait","isGroupPrimary":true,"assetGroupId":"ag_1","linkedAssets":[{"mediaName":"X__H01_9x16.mp4","mediaType":"video","mediaId":"1234567890","thumbnailHash":"STORY_THUMBNAIL_HASH","placementType":"story"}]} Save and update return display.totalAdSets, display.totalAds and the ads in each ad set as the web uploader renders them. Compare these with preview totals before creating. If display.complete is false, read its reason before comparing. Fields in display.inheritedFromSource.fields come from the source ad or preset. With inheritedFromSource.loadedAt they show its values; otherwise they are null (see reason), so read them from ads_preview. Existing destinations show adSetId and campaignId; names show when they are the ad set or campaign of the source ad. Treat any other mismatch for a complete display as a bug and call ads_report_issue with buildId, expected and actual. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd with no campaign or adSet creates a new paused campaign and ad set from the template settings. Cross-campaign create/preview is available only for direct agent requests. Saved builds and Agent Inbox launches must use the template ad's campaign or a new campaign; to save a build for another existing campaign, copy from an ad in that campaign (campaign.id + adSet.id picks one). Existing stored cross-campaign builds can still launch, but cannot be re-saved. The same goes for ad sets: a saved build that names an existing ad set must name the template ad's own ad set, or use a new ad set; to post into another existing ad set, copy from an ad in that ad set or launch directly without saving a build. A stored build that names another ad set can still launch from the CLI and MCP, but must be changed in the uploader before it launches there.

tools.description: Get one saved build by ID. Returns the full spec without truncation. tools.name: ads_fork_build
tools.description: Fork a saved build into a new autosaved draft. Use this instead of editing the existing build when the user wants a variant and the original must stay intact. The fork copies the uploader configuration and media references, receives a new build ID, and can be edited independently. Confirm that the fork was created; share its URL only when the user asks for it or says there is no open uploader tab. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. A stored build that names another ad set can still launch from the CLI and MCP, but must be changed in the uploader before it launches there.

buildId.description: Saved build ID to duplicate, e.g. build_abc123...

tools.name: ads_update_build

Uploaded-media partnerships support profile.partnership for a shared Second Identity and texts.perAd/perAdset sponsor overrides, including both IDs null for No Partner. These builds launch through the CLI and MCP and hydrate their identities in the web uploader. Approval is rechecked at preview and launch. Prefer specPatch for content edits: omitted fields survive and nested text entries merge field-by-field, so changing headlines does not clear link, displayUrl, CTA, URL tags, or AI disclosure. Uploaded-media texts.perAd keys are file names or media:<uploadId>; a file name that two uploads share is refused, so rename one or use media:<uploadId>. CTA fields use Meta enum values such as SHOP_NOW. Standard ads normalize human labels such as Shop Now; imported partnership posts require the enum and do not normalize labels. specPatch requires the revision from ads_get_build as expectedRevision. Send edits to a build one at a time, never in parallel. Changes to spec, webState, mediaItems or uploadBatchId bump the revision. A rename or notes-only update does not bump it. Batch many ad edits into one specPatch where you can. On "Build changed since it was read" (HTTP 409), call ads_get_build again and retry with its current revision as expectedRevision. Use spec only for a full rewrite because it replaces the whole portable spec. Do not construct webState by hand; only round-trip an unchanged webState previously read from the build. When only portable spec changes, the web uploader regenerates webState on next resume. Setting a name promotes an autosaved build to a kept, named build. Returns updated metadata only; call ads_get_build again to read the stored state. Confirm that the update was saved; an open uploader tab picks it up automatically. Share the build url only when the user asks for it or says the tab is closed. Do not surface webStateStale or launchable/launchBlockers unless the user asked about launching from the CLI/MCP: webStateStale:true after a spec edit is normal and clears itself when the web uploader next opens the build, and launchable only describes headless ads_create launches - it never prevents opening, editing, or launching the build in the web uploader. Save and update return display.totalAdSets, display.totalAds and the ads in each ad set as the web uploader renders them. Compare these with preview totals before creating. If display.complete is false, read its reason before comparing. Fields in display.inheritedFromSource.fields come from the source ad or preset. With inheritedFromSource.loadedAt they show its values; otherwise they are null (see reason), so read them from ads_preview. Existing destinations show adSetId and campaignId; names show when they are the ad set or campaign of the source ad. Treat any other mismatch for a complete display as a bug and call ads_report_issue with buildId, expected and actual. Preset-only requests reuse the saved campaign and ad set, including saved builds. Preview and create add a non-fatal PRESET_DESTINATION_USED warning. Use campaign.name or named multi-campaign entries for new campaigns, or campaign.id / adSet.id to override the saved destination. With campaign.id alone, new ad sets are created. copyFromAd with no campaign or adSet creates a new paused campaign and ad set from the template settings. Cross-campaign create/preview is available only for direct agent requests. Saved builds and Agent Inbox launches must use the template ad's campaign or a new campaign; to save a build for another existing campaign, copy from an ad in that campaign (campaign.id + adSet.id picks one). Existing stored cross-campaign builds can still launch, but cannot be re-saved. The same goes for ad sets: a saved build that names an existing ad set must name the template ad's own ad set, or use a new ad set; to post into another existing ad set, copy from an ad in that ad set or launch directly without saving a build. A stored build that names another ad set can still launch from the CLI and MCP, but must be changed in the uploader before it launches there.

expectedRevision.description: Revision returned by ads_get_build. Required with specPatch and recommended for every update; the update fails instead of overwriting a newer revision.

name.description: New build name. Setting a name marks the build as manually saved, so it stops rotating out with autosaves.

notes.description: Free-form notes stored on the build.

spec.description: Replacement portable spec (the launch configuration used by ads_create with buildId). Send the FULL updated spec object, not a partial diff. Set to null to clear it.

specPatch.description: Preferred for content edits. Field-aware merge patch applied to the stored portable spec: omitted fields survive, nested objects (including individual texts.perAd/perAdset entries) merge, supplied arrays replace, and null removes a field. Requires expectedRevision. Computed launchability metadata cannot be patched.

webState.description: Opaque web uploader session snapshot. Do not construct this object by hand. Only send it when round-tripping a webState previously read from the build without changing its structure. For content changes, update spec only; the web uploader regenerates webState on its next resume.

tools.name: ads_create
tools.description: For existing destinations use campaign.id and adSet.id (never existingCampaignId or existingAdSetId); campaign.name and adSet.name request new destinations. For standard ad text use headlines arrays, e.g. texts.perAd["photo.jpg"] = { headlines: ["New headline"] }, or texts.common.headlines for shared copy. A singular headline string is accepted as a one-element alias; conflicting headline/headlines values are rejected. Create ads from a v1 AdSpec request body or saved build, including Instagram existing-post partnership ads with common, per-ad-set, or per-ad sponsors and text. Optional productShowcase shows catalog products under a single image or video ad: {enabled?, catalogId?, productSetId?, useRecommendation?}. IDs are digit strings. Recommendations require Sales campaigns; MUST_PICK requires a returned candidate productSetId. Manual selection works on other objectives. Incompatible with Partnership, carousel, flexible, multi-media and existing-post ads. Off disables showing products while keeping the source set. tools.description: Get or resume an ad creation job by jobId. Returns the full result and original stage progress by default. Pass compact:true for an ads summary with created/failed/total counts and progress measured in ads. Includes the last 20 progress.operations (operations:"full" returns all retained operations). tools.name: ads_duplicate_preview
tools.description: Duplicate campaigns, ad sets or ads, the same as Ads Manager's Duplicate. This is the default way to duplicate: use it whenever the user asks to duplicate, copy or clone. Optional reason is one short evidence-based note for the user in their Agent Inbox. Optional runTitle names this batch of suggestions. Pass the reviewId from an earlier preview or duplicate in this conversation to add the copy to that review, so the user approves the run together. Deep copy includes children by default; deepCopy:false copies only the root. Destination must be in the same account; ad sets default to their source campaign and ads to their source ad set. Rename supports {name}, {date} (UTC), {index}; only roots are renamed unless renameChildren:true. Roots default to PAUSED; children inherit source status unless childStatus:PAUSED. Preview warns about ACTIVE children inside a paused copy and flags flexible, partnership, Instagram-post and catalog ads that may not copy exactly; review copied ads before activating. Targeting, schedule and ad set settings overrides apply to copied ad sets. Ad set copies accept budget and bid_strategy overrides when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets (ABO), including copies from campaign-budget (CBO) campaigns. CBO-to-ABO ad set copies require overrides.budget.daily; preview returns ADSET_BUDGET_REQUIRED without a budget. Meta gives these copies a daily budget, so only a daily budget override is supported. Switching a copy between daily and lifetime budgets is refused at preview with BUDGET_TYPE_CHANGE_UNSUPPORTED, including ad sets inside deep campaign copies and CBO campaign copies. Source CBO ad sets have no budget of their own; the source campaign budget is never carried over. For CBO-to-ABO copies, overrides.bid.bid_strategy is required for capped or minimum-ROAS source campaigns or source ad sets with bid amounts or constraints (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED); otherwise the strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP. An explicit strategy takes precedence: capped strategies need a source or override bid_amount, and minimum ROAS needs VALUE optimization and a source ROAS floor or overrides.bid.roas_floor. Updates omit bid_amount when the chosen strategy does not allow it. Lifetime overrides on existing lifetime-budget sources still require a future end time from the source or overrides.schedule.end_time. When copying a CBO campaign, budget and bid_strategy apply to the copied campaign, including deepCopy:false for uncapped strategies; bid amounts and ROAS floors belong to copied ad sets. Capped CBO strategies require deepCopy:true with compatible source ad sets. add.countries adds countries, not a restriction; remove other source locations to target only those countries. Preview includes executionPlan call counts. Copies run serially, object by object, so Meta deep-copy child limits (3 synchronous / 51 async) do not apply. Large copies run as a background job; poll for progress. Always preview first, show the complete tree, skipped objects, overrides and warnings, then submit resolvedRequest with its sourceFingerprint. Set acknowledgeWarnings and confirmSpend only after explicit user approval. SOURCE_CHANGED means material source settings, the child tree, destination or copy intent changed since preview. Preview again, show the changes, and obtain approval for the new preview. Reviewed copies require a new approved proposal. Volatile delivery metadata does not invalidate the preview. SOURCE_GONE or DESTINATION_GONE means a selected source or destination is missing, deleted or archived. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Approval returns status "pending_approval" with reviewUrl; nothing has been duplicated yet: share it with the user, do not retry or apply again; approval happens in your Agent Inbox. Off refuses with AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Allowed (the default) starts a job; ACTIVE copies need confirmSpend:true unless the account approval rule is none. Hosted polling lasts about 40 seconds (local: up to 30 minutes), then still_running includes nextStep to ads_get_duplication; poll the same job until complete. Inspect every created and failed object; partial means some objects were created, but copying or a later step failed. Report each newId, current name, failed stage and plain error. Review copies use pending, approved, made, partial, failed or rejected; partial includes id, currentName, failedStep and retry.available/how. Retry only the failed step from your Agent Inbox when available, otherwise change the existing copy in Ads Manager. Never run the copy again; it would create a second copy. If the user explicitly wants to keep the existing likes, comments and shares (social proof), use ads_duplicate_by_post instead.

tools.name: ads_duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate campaigns, ad sets or ads, the same as Ads Manager's Duplicate. This is the default way to duplicate: use it whenever the user asks to duplicate, copy or clone. Optional reason is one short evidence-based note for the user in their Agent Inbox. Optional runTitle names this batch of suggestions. Pass the reviewId from an earlier preview or duplicate in this conversation to add the copy to that review, so the user approves the run together. Deep copy includes children by default; deepCopy:false copies only the root. Destination must be in the same account; ad sets default to their source campaign and ads to their source ad set. Rename supports {name}, {date} (UTC), {index}; only roots are renamed unless renameChildren:true. Roots default to PAUSED; children inherit source status unless childStatus:PAUSED. Preview warns about ACTIVE children inside a paused copy and flags flexible, partnership, Instagram-post and catalog ads that may not copy exactly; review copied ads before activating. Targeting, schedule and ad set settings overrides apply to copied ad sets. Ad set copies accept budget and bid_strategy overrides when the destination campaign uses ad set budgets (ABO), including copies from campaign-budget (CBO) campaigns. CBO-to-ABO ad set copies require overrides.budget.daily; preview returns ADSET_BUDGET_REQUIRED without a budget. Meta gives these copies a daily budget, so only a daily budget override is supported. Switching a copy between daily and lifetime budgets is refused at preview with BUDGET_TYPE_CHANGE_UNSUPPORTED, including ad sets inside deep campaign copies and CBO campaign copies. Source CBO ad sets have no budget of their own; the source campaign budget is never carried over. For CBO-to-ABO copies, overrides.bid.bid_strategy is required for capped or minimum-ROAS source campaigns or source ad sets with bid amounts or constraints (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED); otherwise the strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP. An explicit strategy takes precedence: capped strategies need a source or override bid_amount, and minimum ROAS needs VALUE optimization and a source ROAS floor or overrides.bid.roas_floor. Updates omit bid_amount when the chosen strategy does not allow it. Lifetime overrides on existing lifetime-budget sources still require a future end time from the source or overrides.schedule.end_time. When copying a CBO campaign, budget and bid_strategy apply to the copied campaign, including deepCopy:false for uncapped strategies; bid amounts and ROAS floors belong to copied ad sets. Capped CBO strategies require deepCopy:true with compatible source ad sets. add.countries adds countries, not a restriction; remove other source locations to target only those countries. Preview includes executionPlan call counts. Copies run serially, object by object, so Meta deep-copy child limits (3 synchronous / 51 async) do not apply. Large copies run as a background job; poll for progress. Always preview first, show the complete tree, skipped objects, overrides and warnings, then submit resolvedRequest with its sourceFingerprint. Set acknowledgeWarnings and confirmSpend only after explicit user approval. SOURCE_CHANGED means material source settings, the child tree, destination or copy intent changed since preview. Preview again, show the changes, and obtain approval for the new preview. Reviewed copies require a new approved proposal. Volatile delivery metadata does not invalidate the preview. SOURCE_GONE or DESTINATION_GONE means a selected source or destination is missing, deleted or archived. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Approval returns status "pending_approval" with reviewUrl; nothing has been duplicated yet: share it with the user, do not retry or apply again; approval happens in your Agent Inbox. Off refuses with AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Allowed (the default) starts a job; ACTIVE copies need confirmSpend:true unless the account approval rule is none. Hosted polling lasts about 40 seconds (local: up to 30 minutes), then still_running includes nextStep to ads_get_duplication; poll the same job until complete. Inspect every created and failed object; partial means some objects were created, but copying or a later step failed. Report each newId, current name, failed stage and plain error. Review copies use pending, approved, made, partial, failed or rejected; partial includes id, currentName, failedStep and retry.available/how. Retry only the failed step from your Agent Inbox when available, otherwise change the existing copy in Ads Manager. Never run the copy again; it would create a second copy. If the user explicitly wants to keep the existing likes, comments and shares (social proof), use ads_duplicate_by_post instead.

Their bid strategy defaults to LOWEST_COST_WITHOUT_CAP only when the source campaign is uncapped and the source ad set has no bid amount or constraints; otherwise supply overrides.bid.bid_strategy (ADSET_BID_STRATEGY_REQUIRED). tools.name: ads_duplicate_by_post
tools.description: Duplicate ads while keeping their social proof (likes, comments, shares) by reusing the same Page post. Only use this when the user asks to keep engagement; for regular duplication use ads_duplicate. Optional reason is one short evidence-based note for the user in their Agent Inbox. Optional runTitle names this batch of suggestions. Pass the reviewId from an earlier preview or duplicate in this conversation to add the copy to that review, so the user approves the run together. Copies follow the account's Agent Launch setting on the Account Permissions page, like launches; Agent Edit does not apply. Allowed (the default) starts the job directly. Approval returns status "pending_approval" with reviewUrl; nothing is duplicated until the user approves in your Agent Inbox. Share the link; do not retry. Off refuses with AGENT_LAUNCH_DISABLED. Post-ID copies never require confirmSpend (it is accepted and ignored). Select ads by Page post ID into an existing ad set or new cloned ad set. Use postIds for discovery or adIds for exact selection, never both. Preview returns sourceCandidates and a pinned resolvedRequest. Ambiguous matches require explicit adIds; warned live runs require acknowledgeWarnings:true or useCreativeId:true. New ad sets: newAdSet and newAdSetPerAd copy the ad set given in adSetId, which must already be in the destination campaign and may be empty (it needs no ads). For a brand-new empty campaign, first put one ad set in it with no ads (for example ads_duplicate of an ad set with deepCopy:false), then call ads_duplicate_by_post with that adSetId and newAdSet or newAdSetPerAd for each group, so the ads and their new ad sets are created in the by-post step. Do not duplicate the ads into the template ad set itself. This blocks until the duplication completes or the 30 minute ceiling is reached. If it returns status "still_running", call ads_get_duplication with the returned jobId until complete is true.

instructions: Use ads_list_history for Ads Uploader launches and changes, matching the History page; use ads_get_launch for launch details. Use ads_list_change_history for Meta activity, including Ads Manager and other tools. For Product Showcase (catalog products under a single image or video ad), use ads_list_catalogs, ads_list_product_sets and ads_get_product_showcase_recommendation. Pass productShowcase to ads_create or ads_preview; MUST_PICK requires a candidate productSetId, and recommendations require Sales campaigns. Full catalog (dynamic) ads are not supported yet. Call ads_report_issue when results contradict earlier results, a field is silently ignored, preview totals differ from a saved build display summary, or a tool breaks its description. Include the tool, expected and actual results, and relevant IDs. Compare saved display totals, per-ad copy, budgets and status with preview before creating ads. Read WEB_EDIT_UNSUPPORTED warnings: per-ad-set budgets are preserved by the web uploader but must be edited through the API, CLI or MCP. When a user goal cannot be done with the available tools or parameters, call ads_request_feature yourself without asking the user, then continue with the best workaround.
